title: We have finally listed # PHP2Shell as exploited in the wild with the release of a report detailing the compromise of multiple firewall devic
content_md:
We have finally listed # PHP2Shell as exploited in the wild with the release of a report detailing the compromise of multiple firewall devic

via Mastodon https://ifin.network/t/cve-2026-109618-cve-2026-109619-remote-code-execution-in-php/914

CVE-2026-109618.evidence: Social post from ifin.network states PHP2Shell has been listed as exploited in the wild with a report on firewall compromises.

CVE-2026-109619.evidence: Same post lists CVE-2026-109619 among the exploited PHP2Shell flaws.
